Checked at each Virulence [1297707] running out on players (each player where they stood as theirs ran out, the others at the middle of that moment). The plan is laid over where the raid stood each time (turned, scaled, mirrored if that fits better), so off means further from their spot than half the distance between neighbouring spots (at least 3 yd), relative to the rest of the raid, not to the room. Left out: 39 times it was on fewer than 4 players (passed on).
